# Lumi Hospital

> Lumi Hospital is a multi-speciality hospital in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, with 10 specialities, 12 listed consultants, a 24/7 emergency room, ICU, NICU, laboratory and pharmacy. Patients can book consultations and preventive health check-ups online or on WhatsApp.

A multi-speciality hospital where senior specialists, modern diagnostics and genuinely kind people work as one team, around the clock. Cashless insurance is accepted with insurers and TPAs including Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa, Care Health, Aditya Birla, Bajaj Allianz, Tata AIG, Medi Assist (TPA), CGHS, ECHS.

## Contact
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Email: care@lumihospital.in
- OPD hours: Mon–Sat · 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Sun · 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- Emergency, ICU, pharmacy and laboratory: open 24 hours
- Ward visiting hours: 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM · 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM
- Book an appointment: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html

## Specialities
### Cardiology
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/cardiology.html
From a first ECG to complex angioplasty, our cardiac team covers prevention, diagnosis, intervention and long-term heart care, with an ICU and emergency team on call day and night.
Services: ECG, 2D Echo & TMT; Holter & BP monitoring; Coronary angiography; Angioplasty & stenting; Pacemaker implantation; Cardiac rehabilitation.
Conditions treated: Chest pain; Heart attack; High blood pressure; Heart failure; Arrhythmia; Valve disease.
Specialists: Dr. Arjun Rao (Senior Consultant, Interventional Cardiology); Dr. Vikram Joshi (Consultant Cardiologist).
Recommended health checks: Heart Plus, Executive.

### Neurology
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/neurology.html
Rapid emergency assessment, an epilepsy clinic and neuro-diagnostics help us find the cause quickly and start treatment while it matters most.
Services: Acute stroke care; EEG, EMG & NCV; Epilepsy clinic; Headache & migraine clinic; Movement disorders; Neuro-rehabilitation.
Conditions treated: Stroke; Seizures; Migraine; Parkinson's disease; Neuropathy; Vertigo.
Specialists: Dr. Meera Iyer (Consultant Neurologist).
Recommended health checks: Silver Years.

### Orthopaedics
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/orthopaedics.html
Joint replacement, arthroscopy and spine surgery, supported by in-house physiotherapy so recovery starts the day after surgery.
Services: Knee & hip replacement; Arthroscopy; Spine surgery; Fracture & trauma care; Sports medicine; Physiotherapy.
Conditions treated: Arthritis; Ligament tears; Back & neck pain; Fractures; Frozen shoulder; Osteoporosis.
Specialists: Dr. Faisal Khan (Head, Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement); Dr. Imran Pasha (Consultant, Spine & Sports Medicine).
Recommended health checks: Silver Years.

### Obstetrics & Gynaecology
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/obgyn.html
A Neonatal ICU in the same building and a team that stays with you from the first scan to the first vaccination.
Services: Antenatal care; Normal & caesarean birth; High-risk pregnancy; Laparoscopic surgery; Fertility consultation; Menopause clinic.
Conditions treated: Pregnancy; PCOS; Fibroids; Endometriosis; Irregular periods; Infertility.
Specialists: Dr. Kavitha Reddy (Senior Consultant, Obstetrics & Gynaecology).
Recommended health checks: Her Health.

### Paediatrics & NICU
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/paediatrics.html
Child-friendly consultation rooms, a well-baby clinic and a fully equipped NICU for the smallest patients.
Services: Neonatal ICU; Well-baby clinic; Vaccinations; Child nutrition; Developmental assessment; Paediatric emergency.
Conditions treated: Fever & infections; Asthma; Jaundice; Growth concerns; Allergies; Premature birth.
Specialists: Dr. Priya Shetty (Consultant Paediatrician & Neonatologist).

### Internal Medicine
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/general-medicine.html
Your first stop for undiagnosed symptoms, long-term conditions and coordinated care across specialities.
Services: Fever & infection clinic; Diabetes clinic; Hypertension clinic; Thyroid care; Geriatric care; Preventive health.
Conditions treated: Diabetes; Hypertension; Thyroid disorders; Dengue & malaria; Anaemia; Fatigue.
Specialists: Dr. Sanjay Menon (Consultant, Internal Medicine & Diabetology).
Recommended health checks: Sugar Smart, Essential.

### Pulmonology
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/pulmonology.html
Lung function testing and respiratory care, with ICU support when breathing gets serious.
Services: Pulmonary function test; Bronchoscopy; Sleep study; Asthma & COPD clinic; TB care; Respiratory ICU.
Conditions treated: Asthma; COPD; Sleep apnoea; Pneumonia; Tuberculosis; Chronic cough.
Specialists: Dr. Ayesha Siddiqui (Consultant Pulmonologist).
Recommended health checks: Executive.

### Nephrology & Urology
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/nephro-uro.html
Kidney care and minimally invasive urology for kidney stones and prostate conditions.
Services: Haemodialysis; Laser stone surgery; Prostate (TURP / HoLEP); CKD management; Transplant work-up; Uro-oncology.
Conditions treated: Kidney stones; Chronic kidney disease; Enlarged prostate; UTI; Blood in urine; Incontinence.
Specialists: Dr. Rahul Deshpande (Consultant Nephrologist).
Recommended health checks: Sugar Smart.

### Gastroenterology
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/gastro.html
Diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, liver clinics and day-care procedures, so you're usually home the same day.
Services: Endoscopy & colonoscopy; ERCP; Liver clinic; Acid reflux & IBS clinic; GI bleeding care; Nutrition support.
Conditions treated: Acidity & GERD; Fatty liver; Hepatitis; Gallstones; IBS; Ulcers.
Specialists: Dr. Nikhil Varma (Consultant Gastroenterologist).
Recommended health checks: Executive.

### Diagnostics & Imaging
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/specialities/diagnostics.html
An in-house laboratory and imaging with digital reports, often on your phone within hours.
Services: 24/7 pathology lab; CT scan; MRI; Digital X-ray; Ultrasound & Doppler; Mammography.
Conditions treated: Health screening; Pre-surgery work-up; Injury imaging; Cancer screening; Pregnancy scans; Follow-up tests.
Specialists: Dr. Lakshmi Narayan (Head, Radiology).
Recommended health checks: Executive, Essential.

## Health check-up packages
### Essential: ₹1499 (MRP ₹2400), 34 tests
For: Adults under 35 · yearly baseline. Includes: Complete blood count; Fasting blood sugar; Lipid profile; Liver & kidney function; Urine routine; Physician consultation.
Book: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html?package=essential

### Executive: ₹3999 (MRP ₹6500), 70 tests
For: Working professionals 35+. Includes: Everything in Essential; HbA1c & thyroid profile; ECG & chest X-ray; Ultrasound abdomen; Vitamin D & B12; Physician + dietitian consult.
Book: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html?package=executive

### Heart Plus: ₹5999 (MRP ₹9200), 56 tests
For: Family history or heart-risk factors. Includes: Cardiac risk markers; ECG & 2D Echo; TMT stress test; HbA1c & lipid profile; Chest X-ray; Cardiologist consultation.
Book: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html?package=heart

### Her Health: ₹4499 (MRP ₹7000), 62 tests
For: Women 25+. Includes: CBC, thyroid & sugar; Pap smear; Pelvic ultrasound; Breast exam / mammogram (40+); Vitamin D & iron studies; Gynaecologist consultation.
Book: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html?package=women

### Silver Years: ₹4999 (MRP ₹8200), 74 tests
For: Adults 60+. Includes: Full blood panel; ECG & 2D Echo; Bone density scan; Kidney & liver panel; Eye & hearing check; Geriatric consultation.
Book: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html?package=senior

### Sugar Smart: ₹1999 (MRP ₹3200), 28 tests
For: Diabetic or pre-diabetic. Includes: Fasting & post-meal sugar; HbA1c; Kidney function & microalbumin; Lipid profile; Foot & eye screening; Diabetologist consultation.
Book: https://www.lumihospital.in/appointment.html?package=diabetes

## Frequently asked questions
### Do I need an appointment for the OPD?
Walk-ins are welcome, but booked patients are seen first. Booking takes under a minute online or on WhatsApp.

### Is cashless insurance available?
Yes. We work with major insurers and TPAs. Bring your policy card and photo ID; our insurance desk handles pre-authorisation.

### What should I bring for my first visit?
A photo ID, previous prescriptions and reports, a list of current medicines and your insurance card if you have one.

### How do I get my lab reports?
Reports are sent to your registered mobile number and can be collected from the lab counter.

### What are the visiting hours?
General wards: 11 AM – 1 PM and 5 PM – 7 PM. ICU visits are limited to one attendant at set times; please ask the nursing station.

### Is there parking?
Yes, on-site parking is available for patients and visitors, with drop-off right at the emergency entrance.

## Health journal
### Heart attack signs that don't look like heart attacks
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/journal/heart-attack-signs.html · Published 2026-09-24
A heart attack happens when blood flow to part of the heart muscle is blocked. The sooner treatment starts, the more muscle can be saved.
### The classic signs
Pressure or squeezing in the centre of the chest for more than a few minutes; pain spreading to the arm, jaw, neck or back; breathlessness, cold sweat or nausea.
### The quiet signs
Women, older adults and people with diabetes often feel only unusual tiredness, indigestion-like discomfort or breathlessness without pain.
### What to do
Call emergency services immediately and don't drive yourself. Reaching a hospital with a cath lab quickly makes the biggest difference.

### Dengue, malaria or viral? Reading a monsoon fever
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/journal/monsoon-fevers.html · Published 2026-09-08
Rainy months bring a spike in mosquito-borne and water-borne infections. Many begin with the same fever and body ache, so testing is the only reliable way to know.
### See a doctor if
Fever lasts more than two days, is very high, or comes with severe body pain, rash, vomiting or weakness.
### Dengue danger signs
Bleeding gums or nose, black stools, severe belly pain, persistent vomiting or drowsiness need emergency care, often just as the fever settles.
### Prevention
Clear standing water, use repellent and nets, drink safe water, and avoid ibuprofen or aspirin during a suspected dengue fever.

### Knee pain: when to move more and when to see a specialist
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/journal/knee-pain.html · Published 2026-08-21
Strengthening the muscles around the knee often helps more than rest.
### Usually helpful
Straight-leg raises, cycling, swimming and quadriceps work. Start gently and stop if pain sharpens.
### See a specialist if
Your knee locks or gives way, swells after an injury, can't take weight, or pain wakes you at night for weeks.
### Options
Physiotherapy and weight management come first, then injections, arthroscopy and, for advanced arthritis, joint replacement.

### Your first trimester, week by week
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/journal/pregnancy-first-trimester.html · Published 2026-08-06
The first trimester is when the baby's organs form, so early care matters.
### First visit
Book your first antenatal visit as soon as you know. We'll confirm the pregnancy, date it with a scan and start folic acid if you haven't.
### Normal
Nausea, tiredness, breast tenderness and frequent urination are common.
### Call us if
You have heavy bleeding, severe one-sided pain, high fever, or vomiting that stops you keeping fluids down.

### The Indian diabetes plate, simplified
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/journal/diabetes-plate.html · Published 2026-07-22
Managing diabetes is about balance and timing, not bans.
### Build the plate
Half vegetables, a quarter protein (dal, paneer, eggs, fish, chicken), a quarter whole grains or millets.
### Smart swaps
Whole fruit over juice, buttermilk over soft drinks, roasted over fried snacks, ragi and jowar over refined flour.
### Habits
Eat at regular times, walk 10–15 minutes after meals and check HbA1c every three months.

### Child has a fever? A calm parent's checklist
URL: https://www.lumihospital.in/journal/child-fever.html · Published 2026-07-09
Fever is the body's normal response to infection. How your child looks and behaves matters more than the number.
### At home
Offer fluids often, dress them lightly and use paracetamol at the dose for their weight.
### Come in now if
Your baby is under 3 months with any fever, or your child is unusually drowsy, breathing fast, has a rash that doesn't fade when pressed, or shows signs of dehydration.

---
Health information from Lumi Hospital is general guidance, not a substitute for medical advice. In an emergency, call the hospital's emergency line or 112.
